User story: As a booking clerk, I can book an appointment from a clinic template so sessions are not double-booked
Acceptance criteria: System blocks overlapping bookings for same clinician/room; tested on all 6 clinic templates

User story: As a patient, I receive a reminder 48 h before my appointment
Acceptance criteria: SMS or email sent for 100% of booked appointments in test; message contains no clinical details

User story: As a patient, I can reply to cancel so the slot can be reused
Acceptance criteria: Reply 'C' cancels and frees slot within 5 min; booking office notified

User story: As a clinic manager, I see daily utilisation and no-shows by clinic
Acceptance criteria: Report available by 08:00 daily; figures match source within 1%

User story: As a booking clerk, patient demographics load from the patient administration system
Acceptance criteria: Demographics returned in under 3 s; no manual re-keying

User story: As IT, all access is role-based and audited
Acceptance criteria: Access review completed; audit log captures view/edit events

User story: As a booking clerk, I can manage a wait list and offer cancelled slots
Acceptance criteria: Wait-list patients offered freed slot automatically

User story: As a patient, I can book online

Acceptance criteria: Flag visible on appointment and in daily list
